name: Cat-Tac-Toe
tagline: Classic 3x3 grid, cat sprites for X/O.
description: End-to-end smoke test game. Builds a 3x3 grid, generates cat-themed X and O sprites, wires click-to-place logic, win/draw detection, and a restart UI. The simplest possible end-to-end pipeline exercise.
prompt_template: Build cat-tac-toe in Unity 2D. Use the cat-tac-toe skill end-to-end.
